4,936 likes, 54 comments - masterchefpankajbhadouria on October 1, 2026: "Peanut Butter

A healthy bread spread that is preservative free, refined sugar free, uses dates and honey for sweetness and tastes absolutely delicious!
If you’ve been looking for this, Here is the recipe of a Peanut Butter that you can make from Scratch!
Don’t forget to share this with someone who would love to enjoy this!
Recipe Pinned in the Comments below.

#fromscratch #peanutbutter #homemade #nopreservatives  #pankajbhadouria pankajbhadouria

Recipe: Peanut Butter
Preparation time: 10 minutes
Cooking time: 10 minutes
Makes: 250g

Ingredients:
200g unsalted shelled peanuts
1/4 teaspoon salt 
2 teaspoon honey
2 tbsp peanut oil 
6-7 dates, chopped

Method:
Dry roast the peanuts for 8-10 minutes till fragrant and the skin begins to crack.
Cool completely and remove the skin of the peanuts. grind the peanuts till it turns pasty. Add the remaining ingredients and blend till you have a smooth mixture ready. Store refrigerated.".

5,221 likes, 26 comments - masterchefpankajbhadouria on September 30, 2026: "This was such a precious moment for me in my MasterChef journey!
For three months, we had been away from our families shooting for MasterChef, and then one day we were given the best surprise of our lives. 
Our families were invited on the show and we did not know about it!
Can you imagine the joy of seeing my family after so long?!
As a mother, the most difficult thing for me at MasterChef had been staying away from my kids and then all of a sudden as I turned back,I saw my family standing right behind me!
And how I cried that day!
It was as if all the emotions I had been holding back for so long, suddenly found a way out….
This was the Grand Finale, my final task, and once again, I had the people who mattered to me most standing right next to me.
I was starting afresh. I was starting with the same confidence that I had when I came to Master Chef. 
Their presence filled me with the courage and love that helped me perform my best and finally win MasterChef!

#throwback #tbt #throwbackthursday #pankajbhadouria #masterchef".

8,309 likes, 56 comments - masterchefpankajbhadouria on September 29, 2026: "Bala Baiana
 Crunchy caramel dipped balls with a heart of fudgy coconut laddoos, this is Bala Baiana, a Brazilian Dessert! What appeals to our taste buds here is the familiar taste of coconut and the crunch of the caramel. 
It is quite easy to make, requires only 4 ingredients, and turns out to be a crowd pleaser too! 
Try it out!

#balabaiana #coconutladdoo #pankajbhadouria #recipe #dessert 

[Bala Baiana, coconut laddoo, brazilian dessert, Pankaj Bhadouria, recipe, dessert, coconut fudge, caramel, crunchy, sweets ]

Recipe:

Bala Baiana
Preparation time: 10 mins
Cooking time: 20 mins
Serves: 3-4

Ingredients:
400g condensed milk
2 tbsp butter
2 cups desiccated coconut
1 1/2 cup sugar
1/2 cup water

Method:
cook the desiccated coconut, condensed milk, butter in a pan over medium heat till it starts leaving the sides of the pan.
Cool and shape into small balls.
Cook the sugar and water over high heat till the sugar caramalises to a golden colour. Dip the balls in the caramel and set aside to cool. 
Enjoy!".

5,459 likes, 57 comments - masterchefpankajbhadouria on September 28, 2026: "Chutney Podi   This Chutney Podi is so addictive that I have renamed it Dr*gs!
Dosa, idli, toast, poha and even sabji, you can use it over everything!
And because it has a long shelf life, making it once and storing it works for upto 3 months.
Try it out!

Recipe:
Chutney Podi
Preparation time: 10 mins
Cooking time: 15 mins
 
Ingredients:
1 cup chana dal
¼ cup urad dal
1/4 cup peanuts
2 tbsp dry coconut
1 tbsp oil
4-5 Kashmiri whole red chilies
¼ cup sesame seeds
10-15  cup curry leaves
¼ cup peeled garlic
2 tbsp sugar
¼ cup kashmiri red chilli powder
Salt to taste
 
Method:
Roast the chana dal, urad dal and peanuts together on low flame until golden and aromatic. 
Transfer to a plate and let them cool completely. 
Heat the oil in a pan and fry the garlic and add sesame seeds, red chilies and curry leaves. Roast on low heat until the curry leaves are completely crisp. 
Turn off the flame, add the dry coconut and mix well. 
Once cooled, blend with the sugar, salt and red chili powder.
Store in a clean, airtight container and enjoy for up to 3 months!

#chutneypodi #pankajbhadouria #recipes #dosa #idlipodi".

33K likes, 146 comments - masterchefpankajbhadouria on September 26, 2026: "Wishing all the wonderful daughters a very Happy Daughters’ Day! ❤️
A daughter truly is one of life’s most beautiful blessings.
You spend years holding her hand, protecting her, guiding her and making sure she is always okay. And then, somewhere along the way, the roles begin to change.
The little girl you once took care of grows into the woman who becomes your closest friend, your strength, your comfort… and the one who quietly starts taking care of you.
She understands the things you don’t always say, stands beside you through your strongest and most vulnerable moments, and reminds you that you never have to face anything alone.
And today, more than ever, I realise just how blessed I am to have my Sona in my life. ❤️
From being my little girl to becoming my best friend and one of my biggest pillars of strength… you mean more to me than words can ever express.
Happy Daughters’ Day, my Sona. ❤️

#daughter #happydaughtersday #motherhood #motherdaughter #pankajbhadouria".

4,082 likes, 47 comments - masterchefpankajbhadouria on September 25, 2026: "Sticky Paneer

It’s time for Chili Chicken to step back because here is my recipe of Sticky Paneer! Inspired from the fried Sticky Chicken Wings, this Paneer version is Crispy, Saucy, Sticky & ridiculously Addictive!
Trust me, one bite of this Sticky paneer will send you craving for more!
And it will be a great starter for your parties too and an excellent finger food to enjoy when you have friends over. Goes as a great side dish for your Indo Chinese Menu too!

What other Paneer Recipe would you like me to share with you? 😊

Recipe: 
Sticky Paneer
Preparation time: 10 mins
Cooking time: 15 mins
Serves: 2-3

Ingredients:
200g Paneer
½ cup corn flour
¼ cup flour
Salt to taste
1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder
Oil for frying
2 tsp oil 
1 tbsp chopped garlic 
½ tbsp chopped ginger
1 tsp soy sauce 
2 tbsp sweet chilli sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp ketchup
1 tsp vinegar 
1/2 tsp pepper powder
2 tablespoons cornflour slurry 
For Garnishing:
Chopped spring onions
Sesame seeds 
Fresh Cream (optional)

Method:
To make this, break the paneer into pieces, 
Add the flours and seasoning, Add water to make a coating batter and fry the paneer cubes in medium hot oil till golden and crisp.
For the sticky sauce, heat oil in a pan and add the ginger, garlic and saute till golden.
Add in all the sauces and the brown sugar, vinegar and the corn slurry. Mix well.
Add the paneer cubes and toss well. 
Garnish with sesame, chopped spring onions and toss.
Plate, garnish with fresh cream and enjoy! 

#stickypaneer #paneerrecipes #paneer #recipe #pankajbhadouria 

[sticky paneer, paneer recipes, paneer, sticky chicken wings, starters, finger food, party starters, Indo Chinese food, Indo Chinese recipes, recipe, Pankaj Bhadouria ]".

12K likes, 284 comments - masterchefpankajbhadouria on September 25, 2026: "Finally my 4th and last session of Chemotherapy is done! 
And from here on, the journey to recovery begins. 
The Targeted therapies will still continue for the entire year and so such visits to the hospital every 3 weeks will become a norm. 
But because they will not have the side effects like Chemotherapy does, they will be kinder to my body. 
4 months of fighting Cancer…..
And through all this I had my family, all of you & God by my side. 
Praying for the same Love & Support in the coming days too ✨

#cancer #chemotherapy #chemo #pankajbhadouria #family".
